name: Welded Plate Heat Exchanger
shortDescription: Robust heat transfer in extreme temperatures and high-pressure environments.
description: Welded Plate Heat Exchangers are designed for the most demanding applications where extreme temperatures, high pressures, or aggressive media would cause standard gaskets to fail. By laser-welding the plate pack, these units combine the high thermal efficiency of a plate heat exchanger with the extreme durability of a shell-and-tube.
